Line 15 PIT-ADJ deductions and exemptions 0.00. Line 17 = 50,000.00 + 0.00 - 31,500.00 - 1,000.00 - 0.00 = 17,500.00. By the projection: state_agi = federal taxable income 18,500.00 = 18,500.00; less base deductions 1,000.00 gives 17,500.00. Line 18 tax, schedule as numbers: 1.5% x 8,000.00 = 120 + 3.2% x 9,500.00 = 304; total 424, to the cent 424.00. The table row over 17,400 to 17,500 gives 422; expected keeps the formula figure.
